info.title: Wenmar Open
info.description: Free vehicle data for auto repair shops: VIN decoding and a year, make, model, submodel and engine catalog. No API key and no account. Responses are plain JSON with no wrapper. Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`. Fields and endpoints are only ever added. One address may make 600 requests a minute.

get.summary: The data version, the vPIC release it came from, and when it was built.

built_at.description: When the data file was built, in UTC.

data_version.description: The data release, such as `2026.09`. Also sent as `X-Data-Version`.

vpic_release.description: The NHTSA vPIC release the data was built from.

tags.name: Vehicles
tags.description: Years, makes, models, submodels and engines, each step limited to what is valid for the steps before it.
